posts.text: Aaron Rodgers can’t stand playing at Buccaneers stadium: “It's got to be one of the worst playing surfaces in the league. When we're talking about player safety, that's a real concern. I'm thankful I didn't get hurt today, but I've been injured twice on this field before, and in my opinion, the turf was a factor both times. I know USF plays here, but that surface just doesn't feel very safe. From my perspective, it's a field that needs to be looked at because player safety should always come first.” #Steelers #NFL

posts.author: Blitz_Burgh@sportsbots.xyz
posts.text: Aaron Rodgers explains what happens during halftime and what they were thinking when Mike McCarthy didn’t come in at the half:  “I don't think people realize what halftime is actually like. The coaches usually have a quick huddle in the back, and the players are mostly just talking among themselves about what happened in the first half. Guys are eating sandwiches and bananas, and there really isn't a whole lot going on. At least with this staff, halftime has been pretty straightforward. Then there's usually a rush to get back out there. Ange gives a quick 30-second message, I talk with Tom for about 30 seconds, and it's all a little disjointed. So there really wasn't much different at halftime. It was the same kind of controlled chaos. People just started saying, 'Hey, Mike didn't come in,' and then everyone was wondering what was going on and whether he was okay. Thankfully, he's fine. I mean, he's from Pittsburgh. He toughed it out.” #Steelers #NFL

posts.text: Aaron Rodgers explains the play-calling toward the end near the end zone: “The first play wasn't executed very well, but I think we still had a chance to make the catch. On second down, they were late rotating over, and we just missed the double-team block on the front side. If we get that, it's probably a walk-in touchdown. On third down, it was a run-pass option, and I felt like DK was rolling open. I just missed the throw inside. If I put the ball in a better spot, he catches it and we're not even having this conversation. Instead, we kicked the field goal. Then they got the ball, put a couple things together, and we had to go make it work in overtime. But I'm proud of the way our guys responded. Obviously, we'd have preferred to put that game away in regulation. Still, these are the kinds of moments that matter most for a team that's trying to grow. This was a trajectory-altering win. If you fall to 3-3 with a trip to Paris coming up, that's not where you want to be. Cleveland won today too, so now several teams in the division are sitting at 4-2. That's why this one was so important. Our guys responded when they had to, and they found a way to get it done.” #Steelers #NFL

posts.text: Mike McCarthy on his 4-2 Steelers: “At 4-2, you are what your record says you are. I've always believed that, and I pay close attention to it. We needed a win on the road, and we got it done today. That's a big step for us. We needed to stack two wins in a row, and that's another important step. Those are the confidence-building moments you accumulate as a football team. We've now had two straight weeks of preparation where the head coach can look at everything and feel like it's being done the way it's supposed to be done. Those are the kinds of hurdles you have to clear in the first year of a program. We've had two good weeks of preparation. We've won our first road game. We've stacked two wins in a row. Now we have a unique challenge ahead with the trip to Paris. We're excited about the opportunity, both personally and as an organization, to take our game overseas and represent the Steelers in Paris. We're also excited about the chance to win three straight and stack back-to-back road victories, which would be huge for us.There are scheduling challenges that come with a trip like this, just as there are for every team that has to make it. But we feel like we have a good plan in place and we're looking forward to the challenge.” #Steelers #NFL

Protection and timing are the foundation of everything you do through the air.They do a really good job creating pressure, so that was definitely something we had to account for.” #Steelers #NFL

posts.text: Mike McCarthy on the Buccaneers game: “There was a lot of conversation about those decisions. The big question is always how your defense feels about stopping them in that situation. Obviously, they ended up kicking the field goal, so those are the discussions you work through on the sideline. As for that last drive, I thought our guys did a great job in more of a run-pass option-style offense. We probably could have gotten to some of those concepts earlier in the game, and I think that would have helped us. They're a tough defense to play against, especially when you don't see them very often. The pressure they bring is real.I thought our guys did a really good job running the football. We probably could have had a few more rushing attempts, too. But it was a tough win, and those are never easy.Most importantly, I thought the crowd was phenomenal. Seeing the Terrible Towels out there, especially during the key moments in the fourth quarter and overtime, was special. That's a special road win.” #Steelers #NFL

Eagles RB Will Shipley suffered a partial tear to his plantar fascia in Sunday’s loss to the Jaguars, per sources.

Shipley started in the absence of Saquon Barkley and Tank Bigsby. Now another RB injury, though there’s optimism Barkley will be back soon.

posts.author: NFL.com
posts.text: NFL Week 5 injury report: Player statuses for all 15 games - NFL.com

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text: The Rams signed veteran LB Eric Kendricks to the practice squad.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text: The Vikings ruled out WR Justin Jefferson (ankle) for Sunday's game against the Dolphins.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text: 49ers principal owner Jed York has been suspended for six regular-season games and fined $500,000 for violating the NFL’s Personal Conduct Policy, the NFL announced today.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text:
Panthers Pro Bowl CB Jaycee Horn is out indefinitely after suffering a quad injury in Sunday’s loss to the Browns, sources tell The Ringer and Netflix Sports.

Horn is seeking a second opinion. But he’s likely to land on injured reserve and miss significant time.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text:
Bucs QB Baker Mayfield underwent tests that showed no fracture and no tendon or ligament damage in his right thumb, sources tell The Ringer and Netflix Sports. 

Mayfield will need to regain strength after Sunday’s dislocation and likely will miss some time. But good news overall.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text:
By trading J.J. McCarthy now, the Vikings save over $4.6M in cash and cap space and get an unconditional fifth-round pick in the next draft that, depending how the Giants finish, could end up being a top-150 selection.

Meanwhile, New York adds another former first-round pick QB.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text:
Trade! The Vikings are sending QB J.J. McCarthy to the Giants for a 2027 fifth-round pick, sources tell The Ringer and Netflix Sports.

With Jaxson Dart out for the regular season, New York adds another young QB, while Minnesota gains flexibility and McCarthy gets a fresh start.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text: The 49ers are signing veteran DT Naquan Jones off the Vikings practice squad, per source.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text: Giants QB Jaxson Dart is getting additional medical opinions on his injured knee that will determine whether to have surgery, which in turn will determine whether he can return this season or not. For now, he’s out indefinitely, as ESPN reported. Jameis Winston takes over as QB1.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text: The Falcons placed CB A.J. Terrell on injured reserve.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text: Seahawks RB Jadarian Price, who left today’s game at Arizona with a chest injury, had X-rays that came back negative. More tests Monday, but there’s optimism he avoided any significant injury.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text:
Commanders QB Jayden Daniels dislocated his left elbow again, coach Dan Quinn confirmed, adding that an X-ray didn’t show a fracture.

More tests to come Monday, but Daniels will be out for some time: “We’ll rally around Marcus (Mariota).”

posts.author: schultzreport.bsky.social
posts.text: Sources: The #Seahawks are signing veteran QB Drew Lock, bringing him back to Seattle for a second stint. He will backup Sam Darnold.

posts.author: schultzreport.bsky.social
posts.text:
Sources: Colorado QB Shedeur Sanders is scheduled to visit the #Raiders early next week. 

Las Vegas holds the No. 6 pick in the draft. They have been doing work on QBs and have other QB prospects also coming into their building.

posts.author: schultzreport.bsky.social
posts.text: Spoke with an NFL assistant GM about Alabama QB Jalen Milroe: “He’s one of the most intriguing guys in the entire draft. There’s a narrative that he’s just a running quarterback, but that’s way off...

posts.author: schultzreport.bsky.social
posts.text:
Former #Bucs OC Byron Leftwich is back in coaching as he is joining Deion Sanders’ staff at Colorado.

Leftwich interviewed for multiple NFL jobs this past cycle (Pats HC, Seahawks OC) but now makes the move to college.
